name: Event 201 (JHU/WEF/Gates Foundation)
description: October 2019 high-level pandemic tabletop exercise co-hosted by Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security, World Economic Forum, and Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Simulated a novel coronavirus pandemic with senior government, business, and public health leaders. Open access materials available.
general_score_metric: qualitative facilitator assessment / narrative scenario outcomes (no single standardized numeric metric)
reputation: highly influential; widely cited in pandemic preparedness and biosecurity communities
notes: Part of JHU CHS tabletop exercise series. Open access materials include videos, recommendations, and after-action reports.

institutions: Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security
